title: Surgical-lineage merge manifest (Manifest A / Manifest B) — phase_i pre-flight contract
description: Every required key here is derived from the phase_i_merge.py code path that consumes it, NOT from prose: apply_manifest_a (manifest_type/target_module/operations; per-op op=modify_fields, match, expected_existing, set), apply_manifest_b (manifest_type/operations; per-op op in the SEMANTIC_DISPATCH table, module, match, expected_existing), find_unique (match.source_node/target_node/edge_type) and the op_* handlers (op_reverse_retarget and op_reclassify read op['set']; op_delete does not). manifest_id is OPTIONAL — it is a log label only (T1.2). `preserve` is optional everywhere; when present phase_i verifies those fields are unchanged after the write.

manifest_id.description: Optional log label. phase_i reads it via .get() and falls back to '<unnamed>'.

manifest_type.description: Asserted by apply_manifest_a / apply_manifest_b before any work.

match.description: find_unique() matches on exactly these three fields and aborts unless exactly one live edge matches.

modify_op.description: Manifest A operation. apply_manifest_a asserts op == 'modify_fields'.

semantic_op.description: Manifest B operation. Manifest B is module-scoped PER OP: apply_manifest_b reads op['module'] and ignores any top-level target_module.

op.description: Enumerated from the SEMANTIC_DISPATCH table in phase_i_merge.py.

then.description: op_reverse_retarget and op_reclassify both read op['set']; op_delete does not.
